injuries.detail: Hamstring Strain - Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.
Knee  - Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
Knee Surgery - Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.
Ankle Sprain - Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Knee Not Specified - Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.
Hamstring Strain - Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Ankle Surgery - Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.
Toe  - Mobley (toe) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.
Illness  - Larsson (illness) is out for Friday's game against Cleveland.
Ankle Soreness - Thompson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Cavaliers.
Elbow  - Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.
Hand  - Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Knee Inflammation - Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Bulls.
Foot Fracture - Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Toe  - Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Chicago.
Back  - Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Hawks.
Back  - Swain (back) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Atlanta.
Knee  - Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
Knee Tendinitis - Murphy (knee) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.
Ankle  - Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.
Ankle  - Edey won't play in Friday's game against the Pelicans due to left ankle injury management.
Knee Bruise - Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
Back Soreness - Pippen (back) remains out for Wednesday's game against Denver, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.
Ankle Sprain - Watford (ankle) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
Elbow Infection - McGowens (elbow) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
Concussion  - Post (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against New Orleans.
Knee Surgery - Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Hand Fracture - Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Knee Not Specified - Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Foot Strain - Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.
Suspension  - Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Calf Strain - Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could return as soon as Sunday's game at Washington, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
Ankle Sprain - Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
Ankle Sprain - Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.
Calf Strain - Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Chicago, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
Groin  - Vassell is questionable for Friday's game against the Warriors due to left adductor tightness.
Knee Surgery - Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Hip Soreness - Fox is questionable for Friday's game against the Warriors due to left hip soreness.
Knee Surgery - Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Abdomen  - Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Illness  - Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
Hamstring Not Specified - Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.
Toe Soreness - Bassey is probable for Friday's game against the Spurs due to left toe soreness.
Knee Surgery - Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
Knee Dislocated - Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

Hamstring Not Specified - Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.
Ankle Soreness - Achiuwa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Trail Blazers.
Knee Surgery - Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Ankle  - Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Foot Bruise - Youngblood (foot) is out for Friday's game against Sacramento.
Achilles Surgery - Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
Achilles Surgery - Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Knee  - Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.
Ankle Sprain - Mitchell (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Clippers.

Leg Fracture - Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.
Shoulder Surgery - Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Shoulder Surgery - Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
Knee Inflammation - Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Back Spasms - Williams (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland and remains out indefinitely.
Foot Surgery - Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Knee  - Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.
